senses.gloss: (I)--a son of शिबि after whom the kingdom came to be called. Br. III. ७४. २३; M. ४८. १९-20; वा. ९९. २३-4; Vi. IV. १८. १०.

(II)--Its king married श्रुतकीर्ति, sister of Vasudeva;
1: Vi. IV. १४. ४१.
went to स्यमन्तपञ्चक for solar eclipse.
2: भा. X. ८२. १३.

--people of Kekaya, a northern kingdom enlisted by जरासन्ध against the Yadus. Their princes were stationed on the North during the siege of Gomanta.
1: भा. X. [५० (V) 3]; ५२. ११ [१४] Br. II. १६. ४८.
But they became allies of कृष्ण and took part in the marriage festivities of रुक्मिणी.
2: भा. X. ५४. ५८.
Heard of कृष्ण going to मिथिला, welcomed him and met him with presents.
3: Ib. X. ८६. २०; ७१. २९.
Followed भीमसेन in his दिग्विजय;
4: Ib. X. ७२. १३.
rose against शिशुपाल.
5: Ib. X. ७४. ४१.
Took part in युधिष्ठिर's राजसूय।
6: Ib. X. ७५. १२.
In the महाभारत war, five princes of Kekaya joined the पाण्डवस् against the Kurus.
7: Ib. X. ७८ [९५ (V) १२]; ८४. ५५.
A Janapada.
8: वा. ४५. ११७.
Migration of Yadus to.
9: भा. XI. 2. 3.
